name: design-suite-gate-tools
description: The pinned tools npm run check:cycles and check:duplication run, and Playwright, in whose headless Chromium npm test reads the Modal widths, apart from the package's own dependencies, which consumers install to run prepare. dependency-cruiser needs TypeScript 6 beside it, and jscpd's binary is 42 MB.
